title: enterotyperobustness: sampling-based evaluation of enterotype assignment stability (ERP and ERPM)
description: R package implementing the Enterotype Robustness Process (ERP), which holds an anchor set of samples fixed and varies the clinical composition of the samples clustered with them, and its size-perturbation variant (ERPM), which varies the fraction of a cohort that is clustered, under Dirichlet Multinomial Mixture clustering. It includes the cluster-to-enterotype annotation (rank heuristic and centroid matching), the robustness and entropy metrics, the design-aware statistical tests, and the scripts that produced the figures and tables of the paper "A Sampling-Based Computational Framework for Evaluating Enterotype Assignment Stability in Clinical Microbiome Studies" (Scientific Reports). The package takes an abundance matrix and sample identifiers and ships no cohort data.
